first.rationale: Shorter onboarding directly addresses the current completion decline and may also recover activation, while avoiding immediate pricing pressure on long-term revenue quality. final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable adoption. Do not pursue promotional pricing: despite qualified revenue +18%, verified 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. Qualified long-term revenue was not directly measured for shortened onboarding, so retain uncertainty and measure activation, qualified conversion, retention, and expansion downstream.
